findings.title: Where the error lives
findings.read: Volume is the larger source of error (52.16 yds from volume vs 48.97 from rate). Fix the volume model first; tuning the other half cannot recover this.

findings.title: Volume bias
findings.read: We under-project attempts by 0.26 per player (projected 30.45, actual 30.71).

findings.title: Rate bias
findings.read: yards per attempt is over-projected by 0.08 (projected 7.2, actual 7.12).

findings.title: Opponent adjustment is costing accuracy
findings.read: Error with the adjustment 65.37, without it 63.39. Removing it would be more accurate on this sample.

findings.title: Against the closing line
findings.read: Beat the line on 22/63 (34.92%). Our MAE 65.37 vs the line's 58.47. The book is the better projection.
